referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A full-width athletic portrait pairs a centered large coaching promise with a phone mockup and a small coach-finder action. Minimal fitness product mark with coach, blog and coach-search routes atop the opening image. Soft editorial display serif for motivational statements, practical sans for product features and coach actions. Cool gray, black, white and restrained training-photo red. Athlete photography, phone interface mockups, workout image panels and coach/member portraits carry the story. The full sequence runs from athletic hero and phone mockup to coaching relationship cards to coach conversation phone toward 360-degree roadmap panel, member proof portraits, find-your-coach close. Do not reuse coach portraits, mobile UI, member results, subscription price, training claims or imply a local gym storefront.
